split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before conformance suite bucket
split_policy.positive_rule: conformance positives are canonical Objective-C 3 behavior only after the owning behavior phase claims them
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode, shim, fallback, compatibility, unsupported, and alternate acceptance path cases are canonical rejection, strict-error, known-open, or tracking-only evidence
split_policy.bucket_rule: parser, semantic, lowering_abi, module_roundtrip, diagnostics, examples, spec_open_issues, and workpacks are storage buckets, not support owners
